title: ProviderResponse
description: The completed, aggregated result of a ProviderRequest. StreamEvent carries the incremental view; this is the terminal one, produced after the stream closes. Both exist because TurnExecutor needs incremental deltas for low-latency TTS chunking AND a settled object for the transcript, replay tests, and cost accounting.

breaking_changes: 1.1.0 (ADR-0039): tool_calls[].name now constrains to ToolSpec.name's pattern. stop_reason is now a $ref to StreamEvent.$defs.StopReasonValues rather than a second copy of the enum — same values today, but the two can no longer drift apart silently. Nothing in the repository produces a ProviderResponse yet, so nothing migrates.
compatibility.notes: The eval harness (ADR-0021) consumes this shape to compare providers, so changing it invalidates stored golden results and forces a re-baseline. That cost is why `provider` and `model` are recorded on every response rather than assumed from config — a result whose producing model is unknown is not comparable to anything. Adding a `stop_reason` value is MAJOR; consumers switch exhaustively.

provider.description: Telemetry and evaluation ONLY. No caller may branch on it — ADR-0009 requires branching on ProviderCapabilities, and a static check enforces that.

model_digest.description: Content hash where available, so an eval result pins to an exact artifact (ADR-0013). 'llama3:8b' is not a reproducible identifier.

thinking.description: Extended-reasoning content where the provider emits it. May be discarded by consumers.

name.description: ADR-0039: constrained to the same pattern as ToolSpec.name, so a malformed name a provider reports is unrepresentable here rather than passed inward.

arguments.description: PARSED. Assembled from accumulated arguments_delta fragments and parsed only after the stream marked the call complete — parsing a partial fragment is the classic streaming tool-call bug.

stop_reason.description: `cancelled` is a NORMAL outcome under ADR-0025, not a fault — barge-in produces it on every interrupted turn. ADR-0039: refs the same enum StreamEvent uses, rather than a second copy of it.

estimated_cost_usd.description: Null for local providers. Feeds the ADR-0009 ceiling.

token_counts_estimated.description: True when the provider lacks token_counting; the quota guard then applies a safety margin rather than trusting the number.

first_token_ms.description: Maps to the LATENCY_BUDGET.md 1200 ms target.
